gate_reason: The bounded process-local geometry cache made warm enrichment changed-key proportional, but the complete warm refresh remained 4.992 seconds after the NWS response. Full-set low-detail simplification and full-cache serialization are not changed-alert proportional, so the near-one-second gate remains unmet.

geometry_cache_decision.replacement: bounded process-local LRU keyed by affectedZones and SAME codes

notes: peak_rss_bytes is the sampled process resident set
per-alert zone union duration is accumulated across four worker threads and is not wall time
the pre-existing enriched_geom_cache.json was not deleted; it is now an unused operator artifact
runtime worker evidence is separate from browser proof
earlier network-blocked and tracemalloc-inflated trials were excluded from gate evidence
